rules: A successful start of an enrolled runtime is a restart and increments generation by exactly one with a new 32-hex boot id, fsynced before network activity, including after an unclean exit or power loss.
status/inspection and other read-only local CLI operations are not restarts and must not mutate generation or boot state.
Same-runtime transport retry may replay the exact persisted generation/boot/seq/fingerprint attempt and be classified duplicate by the center.
Restart replay preserves report_id/collected_at/type/body identity but uses the new generation and a fresh valid attempt; the center dedupes by report_id.
The first new-generation replay may be duplicate but must atomically advance the new generation high-water with dedupe; no data is written for an already-stored report.
A retired-generation request is stale_boot_generation; a same-generation different boot id is boot_identity_conflict; no fsynced payload may be lost.
No weakening of signature, nonce, fingerprint, dedupe, boot high-water, gap bounds, revocation, rotation-proof or fsync guarantees is permitted.

cases.setup: Report R is durably committed at the center; its ACK is lost; the agent exits without a clean marker after fsyncing R, report_id and body.

expected.high_water: new generation and first accepted seq committed

expected.filesystem: no spool/quarantine creation or mutation, no corrupt-record move
